Introduction

Eunjung, also known as Elsie, is a South Korean singer, actress, and musical theatre actress under Mask Studio and Likey Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group T-ARA and its sub-unit T-ARA N4. In May 2015, she made her solo debut under the stage name Elsie with the mini album "I'm Good".
